action_items: Minor: PUT /api/bookings/{id}/status expects `status` as query param (not JSON body). Consider accepting body for consistency with modern REST clients (not blocking).

Note: `alerts-btn` and `bookings-btn` testIds from the review request do not exist in current sidebar. Actual ids include `booking-engine-btn` (Reservations group) and no `alerts-btn` was found. Not a bug — request testIds were slightly off, but the functionality being tested (modal backdrop, sidebar sweep) is fully verified via the other listed buttons.
Console hydration warning during app boot: '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>' — harmless React SSR warning but should be cleaned up when convenient.

Nice-to-have: /book/default uses browser-native <input type='date'> for check-in/out. That's acceptable for a public guest widget but could be upgraded to shadcn calendar for consistency (low priority).
